notes: The known seed URL (TIPS 'Artificial Intelligence (AI)' page, ucdenver.edu/tips/...) was fetched but is an approved-tool list and basics page with no rules, so it was not collected. The AI hub pages (ucdenver.edu/ai, /policies---guidelines, /privacy---data-protection) mostly link elsewhere; the policies page points to CU system APS 6012 (collected under colorado-boulder) and Campus Policy 7050 (Academic Integrity, PDF not fetched). News says CU Denver is developing a required syllabus statement and student AI guidelines for fall 2026; not yet found as a published document. No College of Engineering, Design and Computing or CSE department AI policy found.
